title: BFS (Breadth First Search)
intuition: Explore node neighbors level-by-level using a FIFO queue, finding shortest paths in unweighted structures.
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize queue with start node, mark as visited.
While queue is not empty, get current level count.
Add unvisited neighbors to queue, mark visited.
common_mistakes: Not marking node visited immediately at enqueue (leads to duplicates)
Confusion of queue and stack usage
content: Explore node neighbors level-by-level using a FIFO queue, finding shortest paths in unweighted structures.
